title: CFPS Datapack
description: A datapack which can tag every fake players when logging on
body:
# CFPS-Datapack
A datapack which can tag every fake players when logging on

# Version Support
Support Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.2 - 1.21.6

# Usage
Use as a dependency of your datapack when you want to avoid the fake players polluting your player list

# Thanks
This datapack is extracted from TPA datapack. I appreciate me for the contribution (lol).
